s0001.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the yimao new moon, the King of Goryeo, Wang Chŏn, sent his heir Wang Chŏm to court.
s0001.idiomatic: In the tenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent crown prince Wang Chŏm to court.

s0002.literal: On wuwu day, an edict ordered that henceforth imperial commands be written entirely in the national script.
s0002.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ordered that imperial commands hereafter be written entirely in the national script.

s0003.literal: Xindu, Zheng Wen, and Hong Chaqiu were ordered to campaign against Tamna.
s0003.idiomatic: Xindu, Zheng Wen, and Hong Chaqiu were ordered against Tamna.

s0004.literal: Ai Xianbuhua, wanhu of Suzhou, requested to build a fortress at Ox Head Mountain to choke the grain transport of the two Huai regions; this was not granted.
s0004.idiomatic: Ai Xianbuhua, wanhu of Suzhou, asked to build a fortress on Ox Head Mountain to choke grain transport on the two Huai routes; the request was denied.

s0005.literal: Ai Xianbuhua therefore said: "When the Song earlier fortified Wuhe, every officer of the Army Command should have been held guilty.
s0005.idiomatic: Ai Xianbuhua then said, "When the Song fortified Wuhe earlier, every officer of the army command should have been punished.

s0006.literal: If we do not build now, I fear the Song will get there first."
s0006.idiomatic: If we do not build now, the Song may seize the advantage."

s0007.literal: The Emperor said: "Though what you say is correct, if you sit by and watch the Song garrison it, your guilt will not be excused either."
s0007.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "What you say is true, but if you stand by while the Song garrison it, you will not escape guilt either."

s0008.literal: Annam envoys returned and reported that Chen Guangbing, on receiving the edict, did not perform obeisance.
s0008.idiomatic: Envoys from Annam returned reporting that Chen Guangbing had received the edict without performing obeisance.

s0009.literal: The Central Secretariat sent written inquiry rebuking him; Guangbing pleaded that he was following local custom.
s0009.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat sent a written rebuke; Guangbing pleaded local custom.

s0010.literal: The capital medical institute founded by the Muslim Esen was renamed the Bureau of Broad Benefits.
s0010.idiomatic: The capital medical institute Esen the Muslim had founded was renamed the Bureau of Broad Benefits.

s0011.literal: On jiwei day, disturbance of the people by hawk-falcon yards and books of yin-yang divination and portents were forbidden.
s0011.idiomatic: On jiwei day disturbance of the people by hawk yards and books of yin-yang divination and portents was forbidden.

s0012.literal: On guihai day, Ala Haiya and others made a major assault on Fancheng, took it, and the defending commander Lu Wenhuan, in fear, requested surrender; the Central Secretariat learned by relay post and dispatched the formerly captured Tang Yongjian bearing an edict to instruct him.
s0012.idiomatic: On guihai day Ala Haiya and others stormed Fancheng and took it. Defending commander Lu Wenhuan, terrified, sued for surrender. The Central Secretariat learned by relay and sent the former captive Tang Yongjian with an edict to instruct him.

s0013.literal: On dingmao day, the Directorate of the Imperial Library was established.
s0013.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Directorate of the Imperial Library was established.

s0014.literal: On wuchen day, one thousand sets of armor were granted to the Prince of Beiping.
s0014.idiomatic: On wuchen day one thousand suits of armor were granted to the Prince of Beiping.

s0015.literal: Two storehouses, Military Equipment and Ever Full, were established to separately manage bows, arrows, and armor.
s0015.idiomatic: Two storehouses, Military Equipment and Ever Full, were set up to manage bows, arrows, and armor separately.

s0016.literal: On gengwu day, tummen troops of Shaanxi were conscripted.
s0016.idiomatic: On gengwu day Shaanxi tummen troops were conscripted.

s0017.literal: On jimao day, the Sichuan branch secretariat reported: "Song general Zazu Wanshou is attacking Chengdu; Yesudai'er's cavalry is campaigning against Jiandu and has not returned; it is proposed to conscript six thousand new troops on the Jingzhao and other routes as reinforcements."
s0017.idiomatic: On jimao day the Sichuan branch secretariat reported, "Song general Zazu Wanshou is attacking Chengdu. Yesudai'er's cavalry is campaigning against Jiandu and has not returned. We propose conscripting six thousand new troops from Jingzhao and other routes as reinforcements."

s0019.literal: An edict dispatched Zhasuha Yahashan and Cui Shao with one hundred thousand taels of gold, ordering Prince Aq Buqa to purchase medicines in Ceylon.
s0019.idiomatic: An edict sent Zhasuha Yahashan and Cui Shao with one hundred thousand taels of gold, ordering Prince Aq Buqa to buy medicines in Ceylon.

s0020.literal: On renwu day, those meritorious in Heke's eastern Chuan army command were rewarded.
s0020.idiomatic: On renwu day meritorious soldiers under Heke's eastern Chuan command were rewarded.

s0021.literal: Heke requested to establish two garrisons at Yunmen Mountain north of the Qu River and Tiger Head Mountain on the western bank of the Jialing, submitted maps thereof, and further asked for twenty thousand additional troops.
s0021.idiomatic: Heke asked to establish two garrisons at Yunmen Mountain north of the Qu River and Tiger Head Mountain on the Jialing's west bank, submitted maps, and requested twenty thousand additional troops.

s0022.literal: An edict granted five thousand newly conscripted troops of Jingzhao to augment them.
s0022.idiomatic: An edict granted five thousand newly conscripted troops from Jingzhao to reinforce them.

s0023.literal: Second month, bingxu day: because the empress and crown prince received seals and regalia, Director of Ceremonies He Dan was dispatched to announce this at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0023.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the second month, because the empress and crown prince had received seals and regalia, Director of Ceremonies He Dan was sent to report it at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0024.literal: On bingshen day, Axu, chieftain of Luoyu in Yunnan, rebelled; an edict ordered the responsible offices to settle the people and offered reward to whoever could capture and kill Axu.
s0024.idiomatic: On bingshen day Axu, chieftain of Luoyu in Yunnan, rebelled. An edict ordered officials to settle the people and offered a reward for capturing and killing him.

s0025.literal: Adjudication official Maixiao was dispatched to audit the revenues and grain accounts of the Chuan-Shaanxi branch secretariat.
s0025.idiomatic: Adjudication official Maixiao was sent to audit revenues and grain accounts of the Chuan-Shaanxi branch secretariat.

s0026.literal: An edict tried Marasila, Qitai Tuoyin, and Liu Yuan, envoys to Burma, instructing them to send sons, brothers, and close ministers to court.
s0026.idiomatic: An edict reviewed Marasila, Qitai Tuoyin, and Liu Yuan, envoys to Burma, directing them to send sons, brothers, and close ministers to court.

s0027.literal: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo, because imperial armies were campaigning against Tamna, requested an order forbidding captive plunder and allowing him to manufacture his own weapons; this was granted.
s0027.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo, with imperial armies campaigning against Tamna, asked for orders forbidding captive plunder and allowing him to manufacture weapons; the request was granted.

s0028.literal: On dingwei day, Song Grand Coordinator of Jingxi and prefect of Xiangyang Lu Wenhuan surrendered the city.
s0028.idiomatic: On dingwei day Lu Wenhuan, Song grand coordinator of Jingxi and prefect of Xiangyang, surrendered the city.

s0029.literal: Third month, on the jiayin new moon, an edict again instructed the Commission of Agriculture to dispatch envoys on circuit to promote farming, insisting that agricultural work succeed.
s0029.idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the third month an edict again directed the Commission of Agriculture to send envoys on circuit to promote farming and see that the work succeeded.

s0030.literal: On yichou day, the Privy Council was ordered that Lu Wenhuan of Xiangyang lead his officers to the capital;
s0030.idiomatic: On yichou day the Privy Council was ordered to have Lu Wenhuan of Xiangyang lead his officers to the capital;

s0031.literal: veteran-coupon troops together with city-dwelling people were to remain at Xiangyang, and fields and oxen were granted them;
s0031.idiomatic: veteran-coupon troops and townspeople were to remain in Xiangyang with fields and oxen granted them;

s0032.literal: new-coupon troops were to be distributed among the various wanhu wings.
s0032.idiomatic: new-coupon troops were to be assigned among the various wanhu wings.

s0033.literal: Wenhuan and others departed Xiangyang; capable Mongols and Han were selected to escort them on the journey.
s0033.idiomatic: Wenhuan and his party left Xiangyang, escorted by selected capable Mongols and Han.

s0034.literal: On bingyin day, the Emperor attended the Broad Cold Hall, dispatching Acting Grand Commandant and Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Antong to invest the empress of the Hongjira clan with jade seal and regalia, and dispatching Acting Grand Commandant and Associate Privy Councillor Bayan to invest Crown Prince Zhenjin with gold seal and regalia.
s0034.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Emperor attended the Broad Cold Hall. Acting grand commandant and right chancellor Antong was sent to invest the empress of the Hongjira clan with jade seal and regalia; acting grand commandant and associate privy councillor Bayan was sent to invest Crown Prince Zhenjin with gold seal and regalia.

s0035.literal: On xinwei day, because the empress and crown prince had received seals and regalia, an edict proclaimed this to all under Heaven.
s0035.idiomatic: On xinwei day, because the empress and crown prince had received seals and regalia, an edict proclaimed it throughout the realm.

s0036.literal: Liu Zheng requested to train fifty or sixty thousand naval troops and to build two thousand warships at Xingyuan, Jin, Yang, Bianliang, and other places; this was granted.
s0036.idiomatic: Liu Zheng asked to train fifty or sixty thousand naval troops and build two thousand warships at Xingyuan, Jin, Yang, Bianliang, and elsewhere; the request was granted.

s0037.literal: On renshen day, the state of Jinzhi was divided into two circuits.
s0037.idiomatic: On renshen day the state of Jinzhi was split into two circuits.

s0038.literal: On guiyou day, a guest star, blue-white like powdered floss, rose from Bi, crossed north of Wuche, again passed from Wenchang through the Dipper's handle, traversed Geng River, and reached Left Sheti — in all twenty-one days.
s0038.idiomatic: On guiyou day a guest star, blue-white as powdered floss, rose from Bi, passed north of Wuche, threaded Wenchang through the Dipper handle, crossed Geng River to Left Sheti, and lasted twenty-one days.

s0039.literal: Former Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Yelü Zhu was made Grand Councillor for military and state affairs; Left Associate Zhang Hui was made Right Associate.
s0039.idiomatic: Former left chancellor Yelü Zhu was made grand councillor for military and state affairs; left associate Zhang Hui became right associate.

s0041.literal: Yan Zhongfan of western Shu was dismissed for crimes; Chaqilhua and others were dispatched to pacify soldiers and civilians.
s0041.idiomatic: Yan Zhongfan of western Shu was dismissed for misconduct; Chaqilhua and others were sent to pacify the army and people.

s0042.literal: The branch secretariat of Zhongxing and other places was abolished.
s0042.idiomatic: The Zhongxing branch secretariat was abolished.

s0043.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the guiwei new moon, Ala Haiya, because Lu Wenhuan had come to court, invested Wenhuan as Grand General of Manifest Valor, Commander of the Imperial Guard, and Grand Governor of Xiang-Han, granting his officers graded rewards.
s0043.idiomatic: On the guiwei new moon of the fourth month of summer Ala Haiya invested Lu Wenhuan, who had come to court, as grand general of manifest valor, commander of the imperial guard, and grand governor of Xiang-Han, with graded rewards for his officers.

s0044.literal: At the time generals, chancellors, and great ministers all requested a campaign south on grounds of Song offenses; Yao Shu, Xu Heng, Tushan Gonglu, and others were summoned by relay post to consult on strategy.
s0044.idiomatic: At the time generals, chancellors, and leading ministers all urged a southern campaign on grounds of Song offenses. Yao Shu, Xu Heng, Tushan Gonglu, and others were summoned by relay post to advise on strategy.

s0045.literal: Gonglu replied: "Riding the momentum of splitting bamboo, sweeping the Three Wu — this is the moment."
s0045.idiomatic: Gonglu replied, "With bamboo-splitting momentum, to sweep the Three Wu — this is the moment."

s0047.literal: An edict abolished the Henan branch secretariat and assigned Shi Tianze, grand councillor for military and state affairs, Aju, grand councillor, and Ala Haiya, vice grand councillor, to conduct privy council affairs of Jinghu and other routes, garrisoning Xiangyang;
s0047.idiomatic: An edict abolished the Henan branch secretariat and placed Shi Tianze, grand councillor for military and state affairs, Aju, grand councillor, and Ala Haiya, vice grand councillor, in charge of the Jinghu branch privy council at Xiangyang;

s0048.literal: Left Chancellor He Dan, concurrent central secretariat associate Liu Zheng, and Shandong grand marshals Tachu and Dong Wenbing to conduct privy council affairs of Huai-Xi and other routes, guarding Zhengyang.
s0048.idiomatic: left chancellor He Dan, concurrent secretariat associate Liu Zheng, and Shandong grand marshals Tachu and Dong Wenbing were placed in charge of the Huai-Xi branch privy council at Zhengyang.

s0049.literal: Tianze and others took leave at audience; an edict instructed them that south of Xiangyang there were many fortresses and stockades that might be seized by opportune advance.
s0049.idiomatic: Tianze and the others took their leave at audience. An edict told them that south of Xiangyang lay many fortresses and stockades that might be taken by timely advance.

s0050.literal: Five thousand ingots of paper money were further granted to reward troops and relieve newly submitted soldiers and civilians.
s0050.idiomatic: Five thousand ingots of paper money were also granted to reward the troops and relieve newly submitted soldiers and civilians.

s0051.literal: On jiashen day, monopoly taxes of Longxing Circuit were remitted for three years.
s0051.idiomatic: On jiashen day monopoly taxes on Longxing Circuit were remitted for three years.

s0052.literal: On dingyou day, an edict ordered that southern scholars who had been kidnapped and sold be redeemed by the government and restored to civilian status.
s0052.idiomatic: On dingyou day an edict ordered the government to redeem southern scholars kidnapped and sold into bondage and restore them to civilian status.

s0053.literal: On xinchou day, the Sichuan branch secretariat was abolished; Wang Liangchen, convenient commander-in-chief of the twenty-four districts of Gongchang, was assigned to conduct the western Chuan privy council; Heke, army commander of Lang, Peng, Guangan, Shunqing, Kuifu, and Lizhou routes of eastern Chuan, was assigned to conduct the eastern Chuan privy council; eastern Chuan deputy commander Wang Zhongren was made co-signatory for conducting branch privy council affairs; and Wang Liangchen was further ordered to lead his command thither at once.
s0053.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Sichuan branch secretariat was abolished. Wang Liangchen, convenient commander-in-chief of Gongchang's twenty-four districts, took charge of the western Chuan privy council; Heke, eastern Chuan army commander of Lang, Peng, Guangan, Shunqing, Kuifu, and Lizhou routes, took charge of the eastern Chuan privy council; deputy commander Wang Zhongren became co-signatory of the branch privy council; Wang Liangchen was ordered to lead his troops there at once.

s0054.literal: Fifth month, on the renzi new moon, the old system for internal and external officials was restored — promotion once every three years.
s0054.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the fifth month the old system for civil and military officials was restored, with promotion every three years.

s0055.literal: On jiayin day, masterless soldiers following the main armies in killing and plunder were forbidden; those willing to enter service were allowed.
s0055.idiomatic: On jiayin day masterless soldiers following main armies in killing and plunder were forbidden; those willing to enlist were allowed.

s0056.literal: On wuchen day, an edict stated: "Prisoners throughout the realm, except murderers awaiting sentence, are all to be released on bail, with a limit that they reach the capital within the eighth month; those arriving on time shall all be pardoned."
s0056.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict read, "Prisoners throughout the realm, except murderers awaiting sentence, are all to be released on bail, required to reach the capital by the eighth month; those who arrive on time shall all be pardoned."

s0057.literal: On yihai day, an edict stated: "Remit the silk and silver that civilians pay on behalf of conscript households, and the taxes of woodcutting households.
s0057.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict remitted silk and silver that civilians paid on behalf of conscript households and taxes on woodcutting households.

s0058.literal: Those unable to repay official debts of the previous dynasty were not to be assessed.
s0058.idiomatic: Those unable to repay official debts from the previous dynasty were not to be pursued.

s0059.literal: Custodians who had lost official funds were beaten and released.
s0059.idiomatic: Custodians who had lost official funds were flogged and released.

s0060.literal: Soldiers killed in battle and construction artisans without adult labor or property received graded additional rations.
s0060.idiomatic: Soldiers killed in battle and construction artisans without adult labor or property received additional rations according to need.

s0061.literal: Xiong and Yi Prefectures were again placed under the capital jurisdiction.
s0061.idiomatic: Xiong and Yi Prefectures were again placed under capital jurisdiction.

s0062.literal: On gengchen day, Orghuz and other meritorious wanhu of Xiangyang were rewarded with silver, paper money, and clothing in varying amounts.
s0062.idiomatic: On gengchen day Orghuz and other meritorious Xiangyang wanhu received graded rewards of silver, paper money, and clothing.

s0063.literal: Sixth month, yiyou day: famine among the people under Prince Tachar was relieved.
s0063.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the sixth month famine among the people under Prince Tachar was relieved.

s0064.literal: On dinghai day, bow, arrow, and armor artisans of all routes were placed under the Military Equipment Directorate.
s0064.idiomatic: On dinghai day bow, arrow, and armor artisans of every route were placed under the Military Equipment Directorate.

s0065.literal: Corvée and tax levies of the Dadu and Nanjing circuits were remitted to ease the people's burden.
s0065.idiomatic: Corvée and tax levies on the Dadu and Nanjing circuits were remitted to ease the people's burden.

s0066.literal: The post stations of Ganzhou and other places were given relief.
s0066.idiomatic: Post stations at Ganzhou and elsewhere were given relief.

s0067.literal: On xinmao day, impoverished and distressed troops of Shaanxi were weeded out.
s0067.idiomatic: On xinmao day impoverished and distressed Shaanxi troops were weeded out.

s0068.literal: Because Liu Zheng and Ala Haiya could not cooperate, the armies were divided in two, each commanding one.
s0068.idiomatic: Because Liu Zheng and Ala Haiya could not get along, the army was split in two, each commanding one part.

s0069.literal: On guisi day, Xiangyang was ordered to build one thousand war vessels.
s0069.idiomatic: On guisi day Xiangyang was ordered to build one thousand war vessels.

s0070.literal: On jiawu day, the Resources Storehouse was renamed the Directorate of Utility.
s0070.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Resources Storehouse was renamed the Directorate of Utility.

s0071.literal: On dingyou day, pacification commissions of Guang Prefecture and other places were established.
s0071.idiomatic: On dingyou day pacification commissions were established at Guang Prefecture and elsewhere.

s0072.literal: On wushen day, Xindu and others of the pacification command reached Tamna and pacified the territory.
s0072.idiomatic: On wushen day Xindu's pacification forces reached Tamna and pacified the territory.

s0073.literal: An edict made Shimir pacification commissioner of Tamna, with Yin Bangbao as deputy.
s0073.idiomatic: An edict made Shimir pacification commissioner of Tamna, with Yin Bangbao as deputy.

s0074.literal: The Arch Guard was promoted to a commanderate.
s0074.idiomatic: The Arch Guard was promoted to a commanderate.

s0075.literal: Envoy to Japan Zhao Liangbi reached Dazaifu and returned, submitting a full report on Japanese rulers' ranks and titles, the names and numbers of provinces and districts, customs, and local products.
s0075.idiomatic: Zhao Liangbi, envoy to Japan, reached Dazaifu and returned, submitting a full report on Japanese rulers' ranks and titles, provinces and districts, customs, and local products.

s0076.literal: Intercalary month, on the guichou day, all circuits were ordered to make ten thousand suits of armor and five thousand bows for the Huai-Xi branch privy council.
s0076.idiomatic: On guichou day of the intercalary month all circuits were ordered to make ten thousand suits of armor and five thousand bows for the Huai-Xi branch privy council.

s0077.literal: On jisi day, the eastern and western Chuan army commands were abolished.
s0077.idiomatic: On jisi day the eastern and western Chuan army commands were abolished.

s0078.literal: On xinwei day, because the Hanlin Academy was compiling the national history, an edict ordered collection of facts from successive reigns to prepare compilation.
s0078.idiomatic: On xinwei day, with the Hanlin Academy compiling the national history, an edict ordered collection of facts from successive reigns for compilation.

s0079.literal: On bingzi day, Grand Councillor Sayyid Ajall was assigned to conduct Yunnan branch secretariat affairs, commanding the various tribes of Helazhang, Yachi, Chike, Jinzhi, and Chaghanzhang; he was granted twenty-five thousand taels of silver and five hundred ingots of paper money.
s0079.idiomatic: On bingzi day grand councillor Sayyid Ajall was placed in charge of Yunnan, commanding the tribes of Helazhang, Yachi, Chike, Jinzhi, and Chaghanzhang; he received twenty-five thousand taels of silver and five hundred ingots of paper money.

s0080.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinsi day: eight hundred troops of Jin Prefecture and the army command returned to Chengdu; one thousand Hulanchi troops were assigned to eastern Chuan.
s0080.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the seventh month of autumn eight hundred Jin Prefecture troops and the army command returned to Chengdu; one thousand Hulanchi troops were assigned to eastern Chuan.

s0081.literal: On renwu day, because the Imperial Ancestral Temple was under repair and spirit tablets were to be moved to a side hall, Ulghulghudai and Zhang Wenqian were dispatched to offer sacrifice and announce this.
s0081.idiomatic: On renwu day, with the Imperial Ancestral Temple under repair and spirit tablets to be moved to a side hall, Ulghulghudai and Zhang Wenqian were sent to sacrifice and announce it.

s0082.literal: On bingxu day, the Privy Council was ordered: "Xiangyang new-coupon troops without wives and children are to be sent to the capital, with additional guards escorting them; the aged and sick are to be sent home."
s0082.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Privy Council was ordered: "Xiangyang new-coupon troops without wives and children are to be sent to the capital with added guards; the aged and sick are to be sent home."

s0083.literal: On gengyin day, Henan suffered flooding; grain was issued to relieve famine among the people, and this year's field tax was remitted.
s0083.idiomatic: On gengyin day Henan flooded. Grain was issued to relieve the people, and this year's field tax was remitted.

s0084.literal: Xiliang Prefecture was merged into Yongchang Circuit.
s0084.idiomatic: Xiliang Prefecture was merged into Yongchang Circuit.

s0085.literal: On wushen day, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent Duke of Shun'an Wang Chong and Associate Privy Councillor Song Zongli to congratulate the completion of the empress's and crown prince's investiture rites.
s0085.idiomatic: On wushen day King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent Duke of Shun'an Wang Chong and associate privy councillor Song Zongli to congratulate the completion of the empress's and crown prince's investiture.

s0086.literal: Eighth month, on the gengxu new moon, of the criminals released from all routes who had come of their own accord to the capital, twenty-two in all were pardoned.
s0086.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the eighth month twenty-two criminals released from all routes who had come of their own accord to the capital were pardoned.

s0087.literal: On jiayin day, the wife of Liu Tie of Baoji County, Fengxiang, gave birth to three sons in one delivery; the household was exempted from levies for three years.
s0087.idiomatic: On jiayin day the wife of Liu Tie of Baoji County, Fengxiang, gave birth to triplets; the household was exempted from levies for three years.

s0088.literal: On dingchou day, the Emperor's birthday; King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent his senior general Kim Sin to offer congratulations.
s0088.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Emperor's birthday, King Wang Chŏn of Goryeo sent senior general Kim Sin with congratulations.

s0089.literal: On jimao day, winter clothing was granted in varying amounts to Xiangyang new- and veteran-coupon troops.
s0089.idiomatic: On jimao day winter clothing was granted in graded amounts to Xiangyang new- and veteran-coupon troops.

s0090.literal: Ninth month, xinsi day: because Liaodong suffered famine, hunting prohibitions were relaxed.
s0090.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the ninth month, with Liaodong in famine, hunting prohibitions were relaxed.

s0092.literal: On renwu day, the Henan pacification commission was established to supply military needs of Jinghu and Huai-Xi.
s0092.idiomatic: On renwu day the Henan pacification commission was established to supply military needs for Jinghu and Huai-Xi.

s0093.literal: On jiashen day, Xiangyang new-coupon troops reached the capital; an edict ordered Bayan to address them, release their bonds, remit capital crimes, allow them to form their own units, and send them against Japan;
s0093.idiomatic: On jiashen day Xiangyang new-coupon troops reached the capital. An edict ordered Bayan to address them, release their bonds, remit capital crimes, allow them to form their own units, and send them against Japan;

s0094.literal: the Privy Council was further ordered to furnish armor and weapons, grant each man paper money to take a wife, and select from among Mongols and Han those fit to lead.
s0094.idiomatic: the Privy Council was further ordered to furnish arms and armor, grant each man paper money to marry, and select capable leaders from among Mongols and Han.

s0095.literal: On bingxu day, Liu Bingzhong, Yao Shu, Wang Pan, Dou Mo, Tushan Gonglu, and others submitted: "Xu Heng has returned home ill; if Crown Prince Tutor Wang Xun were placed in charge of the Imperial University, perhaps Heng's framework would not fall into ruin."
s0095.idiomatic: On bingxu day Liu Bingzhong, Yao Shu, Wang Pan, Dou Mo, Tushan Gonglu, and others memorialized, "Xu Heng has returned home ill. If crown prince tutor Wang Xun were placed in charge of the imperial university, Heng's framework might not be lost."

s0096.literal: They further requested increasing the number of students; both requests were granted.
s0096.idiomatic: They also asked to increase the number of students; both requests were granted.

s0097.literal: Bingzhong and others further memorialized to establish thirty-eight officials from tutor through chief steward of the Eastern Palace Household Office and below.
s0097.idiomatic: Bingzhong and the others further memorialized to establish thirty-eight officials from tutor through chief steward of the Eastern Palace household and below.

s0098.literal: On wuzi day, officials were dispatched to the Jinghu branch secretariat to rank meritorious generals and soldiers.
s0098.idiomatic: On wuzi day officials were sent to the Jinghu branch secretariat to rank meritorious officers and soldiers.

s0099.literal: Hunting within five hundred li of the capital region was forbidden.
s0099.idiomatic: Hunting within five hundred li of the capital region was forbidden.

s0100.literal: On jichou day, an edict ordered that henceforth autumn hunts of deer and swine first offer sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0100.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered that henceforth deer and swine taken in the autumn hunt be offered first at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
